# velin-highlight

Inline text mark (not syntax highlighting — use `velin-code` or `velinSyntax`).

## Values
| Value | Meaning | Bridges to |
| --- | --- | --- |
| (empty / present) | Inline mark emphasis | Mark CSS |
## Example

```html
<div velin-highlight>…</div>
```
